MOTIQ R&D · AI-BOOST

From human instruction to a robot mission.

Our proposal was selected for the ADVANCE phase of the AI-BOOST AI Challenge Competition. In Challenge 1, we are developing an approach to natural-language mission generation for autonomous robots in agriculture.
